content.heading: Procedure for investigation
content.text: If, from information received or otherwise, an officer in charge of a police station has reason to suspect the commission of an offence which he is empowered to investigate, he shall forthwith send a report to the Magistrate and proceed to the spot to investigate the facts and circumstances of the case and, if necessary, to take measures for the discovery and arrest of the offender. For offences punishable with seven years or more, forensic collection and videography duties apply as enacted. Read the official text.
